  • Constructor Details

    • Assassin

      public Assassin(Aabb bodyBox, StatSource stats, Weapon startingWeapon, Armor startingArmor, Aabb hurtbox, int invincibilityTicksAfterHit, PlayerInput input, World world)
      Creates an assassin; the arguments are those of Knight.
      Parameters:
      bodyBox - the box it occupies in the world
      stats - where its stats come from
      startingWeapon - the weapon it starts with
      startingArmor - the armor it starts with
      hurtbox - its hurtbox
      invincibilityTicksAfterHit - invincibility ticks granted after a hit; 0 or more
      input - what the user asks for
      world - the world the player walks in
